newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Elliott hits century as Victoria frustrate NSW.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Elliott hits century as Victoria frustrate NSW.

text.p: Victoria opener Matthew Elliott struck a defiant century on Monday as Victoria reached 200 for five at lunch on the final day of the Sheffield Shield match against New South Wales.
Set an imposing target of 457 to win by New South Wales, Victoria's top order collapsed on Sunday to be 100 for five overnight.
Elliott took his overnight score from 63 to 107 not out by lunch and was at the wicket with wicketkeeper Darren Berry, who was 55 not out.
Elliott was selected on Sunday in an Australian XI to play West Indies in a four day match in Hobart from Friday.
